title: Implementation design: Decal entity, DecalMaterial, shaders (phases 0-2)
author: Alice

title: Verification, test and risk plan for decals (GPU harness, edge cases, both backends)
author: Alice

title: Architecture and data pipeline: level schema, kit manifest, glTF extension, mesh-decal baker, ADR/domain model (phases 3-6)
author: Alice

title: Offscreen targets (reflection probes, planar reflection) have no normal buffer and a different target format: decal pass must be skipped or format-keyed, otherwise GPUValidationError instead of graceful miss
author: Charly

title: Opaque-depth capture is gated on transparents/HBAO only (MainRenderPass.ts:94-148, WebGLMainPass.ts:105-114); WebGL2 DecalMaterial must declare u_opaqueDepthMap in its layout or the capture is silently skipped
author: Charly

title: Transparent sort (Scene.ts:295) is centre-distance only with no tie-break and is cached by camera pos/vp; decal priority must be primary key plus stable id, and priority changes need render-list invalidation
author: Charly

title: Silhouette smear and resize stale texture views are the highest-probability visual/GPU bugs; need probe assertions (smear < 1% of side area, resize 256-512-256 with zero validation errors)
author: Charly

result: Verification plan done: unit test table (DecalMath, sort, gating, assembly, schema, baker), GPU probe harness on puppeteer+readback (GL2 blocking, WebGPU local), edge matrix, per-phase thresholds. Report: .agents/scratches/decal-verification-charly.md

title: Maker has no level.json writer: ADR 0020 'Maker exports .level.json' is aspirational; ADR 0010 mandates glTF+SWM_*. Stamp tool persistence needs a decision (level.json decals[] merge-writer vs SWM_decal)
author: Dave

title: Key conflict: Maker binds R=scale gizmo, E=rotate, X=snap, Z=zone tool (MakerApp.ts:1480-1535); plain D is free. Stamp-mode R=rotate only OK as modal override
author: Dave

title: loadLevel never instantiates environment.surfaces (type only, KitTypes.ts:225): same silent-gap risk for decals. level.schema root and kit.schema decal use additionalProperties:false, must change in lockstep with KitManifestValidator.ts:197-221,316-326
author: Dave

title: Mesh-decal baker on skinned meshes needs weight transfer per emitted vertex: defer; v1 = static receivers, load-time pure CPU function, in-memory cache on KitRegistry instance
author: Dave

title: Prologue migration: 6 planes; drop flipX hack (prologue.ts:785), bake _morgueGroup parent transform into kaeltekammer.level.json (offset UNVERIFIED), keep planes behind flag until projector passes on WebGL2
author: Dave

result: Design done: level.json decals[] primary (SWM_decal later), kit item gets size/normal/orm/emission, load-time pure MeshDecalBuilder (static receivers), modal stamp tool, v1=placement+maps+plane-normal; wetness v1.5; sockets/accumulator later; ADR 0029 drafted. Report: .agents/scratches/decal-architecture-dave.md

title: Decal must not be isCollidable (physics collider + raycast hit) but then bounds=undefined and it is never frustum-culled: needs computeBounds() override forcing an OBB (Object3D.ts:246, FrustumCuller.ts:73, PhysicsSystem.ts:137)
author: Bob

title: WebGL2 blend state is shared across draw buffers; GL normal wrapper writes vec2 o_normal so SRC_ALPHA reads undefined alpha on the normal target. Fix: vec4 o_normal with a=1, and decal shader writes the already-blended normal (replace semantics). UNVERIFIED on GPU
author: Bob

title: Shared PBR lighting chunk uses implicit-derivative textureSample; an early discard for out-of-box pixels is a WGSL uniformity error. Use late discard (cost) or @diagnostic attr (lint-wgsl/wgsl_reflect support UNVERIFIED)
author: Bob

title: Normal buffer can't be sampled while attached: need per-frame normal copy (WebGPU copyTextureToTexture, COPY_SRC exists; WebGL2 blit from COLOR_ATTACHMENT1). Decals get own list+sub-pass before transparents; sort = priority, volume desc, id (no distance)
author: Bob

result: Design done: own RenderList.decals + sub-pass before transparents; DecalMaterial extends AbstractMaterial (FRONT cull, no depth, ALPHA); clipToBox mat4 in matParam0-3; normal-buffer copy; reuse PBR chunk + wrapper for normal write; 3-tap fallback; sort priority/volume/id. Report: .agents/scratches/decal-design-bob.md

reason: Respects level.json primary, SWM_decal for Maker, strict schemas. Wetness re-scope and lit default plus unlit opt-in fine. Decal/DecalMaterial/isDecal fit, no singletons. Phase 3 before 4 sensible. Keep phase 0 as hard gate; no level.json writer in Maker.

v2 matches my T1 design; separate list with static sort, vec4 o_normal alpha 1, no early discard, wetness re-scope and phase 0 gate are sound. Notes: make Phase 0 a hard gate; require WebGL2 MRT blend check there; forbid negative scale in Decal.computeBounds.

Risks 1-3 closed (guard, gating, static sort). Amend: GL o_normal alpha must equal decal alpha, not 1 (else transparent texels wipe normals); add tests for offscreen guard and normal-copy on runtime quality toggle; spike needs numeric go/no-go thresholds.

summary: P1 accepted 3/3 AGREE: consolidated decal plan v2 (.agents/scratches/decal-plan-v2.md) with vote amendments. Open for the moderator: Maker persistence, Maker keys, phase-0 gate.
author: Alice
